verdict.rationale: E2B's docs state that agent code runs in an isolated Firecracker microVM rather than on your server (e2b-docs-44). The GitHub README describes it as infrastructure for running code in secure isolated sandboxes (e2b-gh-3), and docs confirm agent tools execute in an isolated sandbox instead of your machine (e2b-docs-43), with outbound network allow/deny controls (e2b-docs-10). Missing for 10: a dedicated security or isolation architecture doc (threat model, kernel/escape hardening, tenant separation details), a statement that the microVM boundary also holds in self-hosted/BYOC deployments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the boundary.
